name: mref_good
about: selftest control: the same measurement, the motion built from it (0.4 s quad, 0.08 s apart)
bans: crosshair: realistic shooters show only a small dot or nothing — no bracketed reticle
ammo counter: the player can feel the magazine; count down with sound, not a number on screen
compass / minimap: a tactical map is a separate interaction, not always visible
scope reticle: belongs inside the weapon's optic, not overlaid on the HUD
kill feed: a banner row of deaths is a competitive / arcade convention

references.screen: selftest only — not a real game
